title: Accessory Allowance in the Registered Limit of a Northgate Protect Single-Item Plan
content:
An accessory allowance is added to the registered limit of liability of a Northgate Protect single-item plan, shared equally among the device lines of the covered order: the whole accessory amount (a share of 1) for a computer, tablet or mobile phone with accessories, one half of it (a share of 0.5) for an item in any other category with accessories, and nothing without accessories.

The lines are read from the covered order in the customer's Northgate Store and Online Orders records — each line's item category, its return class and its line amount, the net price paid for the line before tax — and the covered item's category is the one recorded on the plan.

## Definitions

- **Device lines:** the lines of the covered order in the covered item's category with the same return class as the covered order line, the covered order line included.
- **Accessory lines:** the lines of the covered order in the covered item's category whose return class is general merchandise.
- **When accessory lines count:** only where the covered order line's own return class is not general merchandise and every one of the accessory lines has a line amount below $20.00, the lowest coverable item price of the single-item tiers, so that no line that could carry a plan of its own is ever an accessory of another item. A general-merchandise line of the category at or above $20.00 may have been bought for its own sake, so the order then counts no accessories at all.
- **Accessory amount:** the total of the line amounts of the accessory lines, where they count.

## Ladder

| Covered item | Allowance added, per device line |
|---|---|
| Computer, tablet or mobile phone, line not general merchandise, accessory lines counted | The whole accessory amount, divided by the number of device lines |
| Any other category, line not general merchandise, accessory lines counted | One half of the accessory amount, divided by the number of device lines |
| No accessory lines counted (none in the category, the covered line is itself general merchandise, or any such line at $20.00 or more) | Nothing |

## Threshold on both sides

- Accessory lines of $19.99 and $8.00: both below $20.00, they count.
- Accessory lines of $19.99 and $20.00: one is at $20.00, so the order counts no accessories at all.

## Cases on hypothetical figures

- A tablet order holds two tablet lines of the electronics return class, a $14.00 sleeve and a $9.00 stylus, both general merchandise in the computers and tablets category. Accessory amount $23.00; the whole of it shared by 2 device lines adds $11.50.
- A smart-home hub order holds the hub (electronics) and a $12.00 mounting kit (general merchandise, smart home). One half of $12.00 shared by 1 device line adds $6.00.
